title: State
description: State or province administrative division with name, code, country, population, and capital city. Used for geographic databases, address systems, and administrative data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the state record

name.description: Official name of the state or province (e.g., California, Ontario, Bavaria)

code.description: State or province code or abbreviation (e.g., CA, ON, BY)

country.description: Country where this state or province is located

population.description: Total population of the state or province

capital.description: Capital city of the state or province
